hero.sub: I'm Dr. Bakr Ahmed, a civil engineer and math teaching specialist. I help my students understand the idea instead of memorizing steps, build real confidence, and reach the highest Score possible from their very first Trial.

about.heading_html: Civil engineer, and math teaching specialist for years.
about.lede: Over the years, I've helped hundreds of students break through their fear of math and turn from students struggling with the subject into students who walk into the exam with confidence. It's not just teaching — I follow up with every student until they reach their goal.
points: Real teaching experienceNot theory — actual experience with hundreds of different cases.
Step-by-step explanationEvery idea builds on the one before it, no gaps in understanding.
Continuous follow-up and error correctionA full team tracks every student's level, step by step.
Goal-driven preparationEvery step of the course is built around getting you the highest Score you can reach.
